summary: This commit introduces a new private helper method `getType` to encapsulate logic for resolving an `IType` from an `ITypeBinding`, specifically handling `ITypeVariable`s. It then replaces a direct ternary expression and cast with a call to this new helper method. This kind of refactoring (method extraction/introduction) is beyond the current capabilities of the TriggerPattern DSL, which focuses on expression-level rewrites or annotation transformations.
